name: PR timeline: severity icons open the findings popover
description: From PR #482's Agent runs tab, the TIMELINE's seeded run row now shows severity icons in place of the plain '2 finding(s)' text (server/src/db/seed.ts links the seeded review to a demo agent_runs row). Clicking the findings trigger pins open a read-only popover listing that run's findings. agent-browser has no hover command, so this exercises the click-to-pin path — the reason FindingsPopover supports it. Read-only seeded data (no model call). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
